hook.h2: He spoke to a teenager before He spoke to the priest
hook.text: Then our Father came, stood there, and called as before: “Samuel! Samuel!” Samuel said, “Speak, for your servant is listening.”
hook.note: Samuel was young enough that he didn’t recognise the voice at first. It called his name three times in the night before anyone told him who was speaking. Your Father spoke to a kid before He spoke to the priest — He knows your name, and He isn’t waiting for you to grow up first.

short350: You have wanted a Father your whole life. Not a doctrine about Him. Not a distant power. A Father — His voice, His heart turned toward you.
Father's Heart Bible is the first Bible in print where you can see who is speaking.
Our Father's words in BLUE. The Son's in RED. The Spirit's in PURPLE.

For a hundred and twenty-five years, red letters have shown the Son speaking. Our Father speaks more than three times as often — 125,457 words across 5,623 verses — and every one of them has been printed in the same black ink as the genealogies. More than one word in four of the Bible is a divine person speaking. The color marks ownership, not quotation: His words stay His on any lips that carry them faithfully, words He never spoke are never colored, and narration stays black.
Samuel was still a boy when our Father called his name in the night, three times, before he knew who was speaking. Our Father went to the kid, not the priest, and He said the name He already knew.
That is what this Bible was made to do. Not to tell you about a Father who speaks, but to show you where He already has.

He is not distant. He is not disappointed. He is your Heavenly Father, and He delights in you as His beloved child. If father is not a word of comfort for you, this Bible is especially for you: the Father revealed here is no projection of broken human fatherhood, but the original, from whom every family in heaven and on earth takes its name.

An introduction opens each book, a Father's note closes each with a short prayer, and 1,354 notes serve the reader, not the scholar. A presentation page carries their name. Six by nine, hardcover, full color throughout.
A fresh translation from the original Hebrew, Aramaic, and Greek — complete, 66 books and 31,085 verses. A gift, a keepsake, an heirloom.
Receive the Father. Hear His voice. His heart is for you.

long.h: Plenty Of Voices Have Something To Say About You. Your Father Wants You To Know His.
body: Samuel was young enough that he did not recognize the voice at first. It called his name three times in the night before anyone told him who it was. "Samuel! Samuel!" — 1 Samuel 3:10

Your Father spoke to a kid before He spoke to the priest. He knows your name and He is not waiting for you to grow up first. It is a devotional Bible for daily Bible reading and intimacy with God, so you hear Him for yourself.

long.h: A Three Color Bible: Red Letter, Blue Letter, Purple Letter
body: The color is a mark of ownership, not of quotation. His words stay His on any lips that carry them faithfully, and words He never spoke are never colored. Our Father speaks 125,457 words here. The Son speaks 39,936. More than one word in four of this Bible is a divine person speaking.

God is our Father. Not a role He plays. Father is who He is, and Father is His name, the name Jesus came to reveal: "I revealed your name to those you gave me from the world" (John 17:6). This translation lets the Hebrew and Greek speak the distinction they always made: God as Father, Abba Father, your Heavenly Father — and you, His beloved child.

If the word father is not a word of comfort for you, this Bible is especially for you. The Father revealed here is no projection of broken human fatherhood. He is the original, from whom every family in heaven and on earth takes its name.

faq.q: What makes the Teen Bible different from the other editions?
faq.a: It is the complete Father's Heart Bible™ in Divine Voice Color — every book, every page, nothing abridged — bound and written for a teenager. It opens with front matter addressed to them: a word about the Father who speaks, a prayer to pray, and passages on intimacy, identity and inheritance chosen for where they are. Through the whole Bible there is an introduction to each book, a Father's note and prayer closing each one, 1,354 study notes, and a presentation page carrying their name.

faq.q: What age is the Teen Bible for?
faq.a: Ages 13–19. It reads at the same level as every other edition — a fresh translation in clear contemporary English — so it carries a teenager through into adulthood rather than being outgrown.

faq.q: Is this a good confirmation or graduation gift?
faq.a: It is made for it. A complete hardcover Bible with a presentation page for their name, in a cover designed for a teenager rather than a children’s Bible or a generic pew edition.

For a hundred and twenty-five years red letters have shown the Son speaking. Our Father speaks more than three times as often — 125,457 words across 5,623 verses — and until now those words were printed in the same black ink as the genealogies. In Divine Voice Color you see who is speaking: our Father's words in BLUE, the Son's in RED, the Spirit's in PURPLE. More than one word in four of the Bible is a divine person speaking. The color is a mark of ownership, not of quotation — His words stay His on any lips that carry them faithfully, and words He never spoke are never colored.
